# kbcli v0.2.0

**Release date:** 2026-11-22 · **Previous release:** [v0.1.1](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/releases/tag/v0.1.1) · **License:** MIT · **Go:** 1.27.4

The first feature release of kbcli. It turns the chat screen into a real
multi-window terminal workspace, streams answers token by token, moves all
first-run and reindex progress inside the TUI, and makes local cross-encoder
reranking the default. Retrieval now routes by intent, and Anthropic Messages
is a first-class chat backend alongside OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions.

See the [full diff](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0)
and [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete entry.

---

## Highlights

- **Streaming answers.** Answers render incrementally as model deltas arrive
  instead of appearing all at once. The busy spinner is suppressed while
  streaming and conversation history is committed once, on completion. Any
  stream failure fails open to the previous non-streaming path.
- **Emacs-style `ctrl+x` windows.** New, next, previous, close, numbered jump
  and a toast picker, all behind a 750 ms prefix that cannot leak into the
  text input. A browser-style tab bar sits above the help line.
- **Fully isolated windows.** Each window owns its transcript, evidence,
  input, viewport, stream state, agent, evidence sink and session memory.
  Background answers return to the window that asked the question.
- **In-TUI boot and reindex screens.** ASCII wordmark, byte- or file-level
  progress bars, phase labels and error views replace every console progress
  line. Chat stays blocked until provisioning or reindex finishes.
- **Local reranking by default.** `aikit` cross-encoder reranking is on out of
  the box, with a managed `ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2` model and fully offline
  `full` release archives.
- **Intent routing and Anthropic support.** `direct` / `quick_rag` /
  `deep_rag` routes choose retrieval depth; `chat_provider: anthropic` speaks
  the Messages API.

---

## What's Changed

### Features

- `agent.StreamAnswerer` / `AskStream` consume `StreamEvents` from the
  `langchain-golang` fork and forward `model_delta.Text` deltas to the TUI.
  `Ask` remains available and unchanged for non-streaming callers.
- `ctrl+x` window prefix with `t` (new), `n`/`p` (next/previous),
  `0`..`8` (jump), `x` (close) and `w` (picker). The picker supports up/down,
  enter and esc.
- Bottom tab bar with an active-window highlight; the input row, tab bar and
  help row are pinned so new tabs only extend the bar to the right.
- Per-window `agent.Answerer`, evidence sink and session keyed as
  `root#window-N`; answer messages carry a window id for correct routing.
- TUI boot screen for first-run model provisioning (`EnsureModel` /
  `ModelProgress`) with an ASCII wordmark and byte-level progress bar.
- Boot-style full-screen `reindex` view with a file-level progress bar.
- `bubbles/key` bindings (`key.Binding`, `key.Matches`, `help.KeyMap`) and a
  shared global `ctrl+c` quit binding.
- Porto-derived intent router (`off`, `binary`, `adaptive`) with five settings:
  `intent_mode`, `intent_provider`, `intent_api_key`, `intent_base_url`,
  `intent_model`. A broken classifier falls back to keyword rules.
- Local `aikit` cross-encoder rerank backend (`rerank_type: aikit`), enabled
  by default with a managed model directory and `rerank_model_path` override.
- `chat_provider: anthropic` (Messages API) with a protocol-appropriate
  default `base_url` fallback, alongside the existing `openai` mode.
- `ctrl+]` toggles the evidence pane; `:q` quits; the TUI theme follows the
  terminal background via OSC 11 / `COLORFGBG`.
- Full offline release archives bundling the binary and all five model files,
  plus `checksums.txt` on every release.
- English and Simplified Chinese strings for every new screen, label and
  key-help entry, with parity tests.

### Improvements

- Chunk defaults aligned with LangChain (`chunk_size: 1024`,
  `chunk_overlap: 200`) and `rembed` input tokens capped.
- Chat messages wrap to the chat pane width instead of running beneath the
  evidence pane.
- Markdown ingestion strips headings so they are not duplicated into chunk
  bodies.
- Reindex runs as a blocking modal with progress instead of interleaving with
  chat input.
- Model provisioning moved from CLI stderr to the TUI, so nothing is written
  to the terminal before the alternate screen starts.
- README and README.zh-CN document the keyboard shortcuts, windows, boot
  screen, rerank setup and install instructions.

### Bug Fixes

- Opening a new window no longer leaves a frozen duplicate input box or
  pushes the tab bar down one row. `App.NewWindow` no longer writes to stderr
  while the alternate screen is active, and the bottom layout reserve is
  fixed at six rows.
- Long chat lines no longer disappear beneath the evidence pane.
- `TestMinScoreAndContextExpand` is now deterministic: it disables the
  now-default reranker and compares the expanded chunk against its parent's
  score, so it no longer depends on whether the model is present locally.

### Removed

- `internal/cli/progress.go` and its test. The console percentage progress
  printer is dead code now that the TUI owns model and reindex progress.

### Testing

- New coverage for the boot screen, reindex view, streaming (agent and TUI),
  multi-window answer routing, window picker, tab bar, prefix timeout and
  managed model provisioning.
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -race -count=1 ./...` are green
  across all 16 packages.

---

## Breaking Changes

None. The `.kbvec` on-disk format, the CLI command surface and the public
configuration keys are unchanged. The items below are behavior changes that
may require action after upgrading.

## Upgrade Guide

1. **Reindex once.** `chunk_size` and `chunk_overlap` defaults changed. Both
   are index-affecting, so existing `.kbvec` files show INDEX STALE. Run
   `kbcli reindex` or `:reindex` inside the TUI before searching.
2. **Plan for the first-run model download.** Reranking is now on by default.
   The first launch fetches five files (~92 MB) into
   `~/.kbcli/model/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2/`. To stay offline, download a
   `full` archive or set `rerank_model_path` to a local model directory.
3. **Update scripts that read stderr.** The CLI no longer prints the model
   download percentage to stderr; progress is rendered inside the TUI.
4. **Review `chat_provider`.** It defaults to `openai`. Users of the official
   Anthropic API should set `chat_provider: anthropic`; `base_url` then falls
   back to the protocol-appropriate default.

## Installation

### From source

```sh
make install
# or
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@v0.2.0
```

The binary lands in `$(go env GOPATH)/bin/kbcli` (or `$GOBIN`). Make sure that
directory is on your `PATH`. Module paths are case-sensitive: use
`github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli` exactly.

### Prebuilt binaries

Two tiers are published for darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, linux/amd64,
linux/arm64 and windows/amd64:

| Tier | Example asset | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | `kbcli-v0.2.0-darwin-arm64` | Binary only; the model downloads on first run. |
| Full | `kbcli-full-v0.2.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` | Binary plus `model/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2/`; fully offline. |

Windows full archives use `.zip` and the binary is `kbcli.exe`.

```sh
tar -xzf kbcli-full-v0.2.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz
./kbcli
```

### Verify downloads

```sh
sha256sum -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
# macOS: shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
```

---

## Known Issues

- Windows runtime behavior has not been verified on real hardware. Only
  cross-compilation and static checks were performed.
- Retrieval expands to adjacent chunks of the same file (`context_expand`),
  not to sibling files in the top hit's directory. Directory-level synthesis
  across files is not implemented yet.
- The managed reranker model is pinned to Hugging Face revision
  `233902d25c440f23af6f7d6e94d2946bac0bee0a`; a `full` archive or an explicit
  `rerank_model_path` is required in air-gapped environments.
